setup: How big, how sunny, how much time. It matches plants that are happy in pots.
map: Your balcony in 3D, at real size
Every pot, trough and railing planter. Tap one to fly in.
jobs: Each planter has its own jobs
Tap a badge and tick it off. Harvests go straight into your pantry.
diary: Watered, fed, a problem, a note or a photo. One tap each.
calendar: Know what to sow this month
A calendar filtered for pots, with windowsill crops like cress and pea shoots.
growth: See it grow before you plant
Slide the growth preview weeks ahead and watch every pot fill in and ripen.

setup: Tell it what you already have
Greenhouse, coop, beds: all on your starter map, with a first bed sized for your time.
plant: It works out how many plants fit
Pick a crop for the bed you tapped. Spacing, rows and the expected harvest are filled in.
seeds: It picks the tray, counts the weeks and tells you when to plant out.
layout: Tap to add a bed, a herb garden or a greenhouse, then drag it into place.
hens: Collect the eggs with one tap
Daily care sits on the coop. Eggs are counted into your pantry.
weather: The 7-day forecast is checked against what you grow, so you hear about it first.

map: Your whole farm on one map
Orchard, paddock, hives, greenhouse. Pick an area and fly to it.
milk: One tap: milk goes to the pantry
Daily care for 14 kinds of animals. Tick a job and the amount is logged.
orchard: Fruit trees crop year after year
Pick the cherries, log the kilos. The trees stay on the map for next season.
animals: Animals, grouped by where they live
Each group keeps its feeding, housing and health guide a tap away.
sell: Sell the surplus, track the money
Pantry stock, sales and costs in one place.
walk: Morning walk: every job in order
One stop at a time. The map shows where to go next.
